newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin convoy leaves specialist heart hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin convoy leaves specialist heart hospital.

text.p: Boris Yeltsin's presidential motorcade of cars and jeeps left Moscow's Cardiology Research Centre on Friday morning, eyewitnesses near the entrance to the hospital said.
The Kremlin press office had no comment. But Russian officials had said on Thursday that they expected Yeltsin to be transferred to another Moscow hospital within 24 hours.

The motorcade, which included the stretch Mercedes limousine traditionally used by the Russian president, swept along a closed-off thoroughfare from the research centre, where Yeltsin, 65, had a quintuple heart bypass operation on Tuesday.

The Mercedes was preceded by a black limousine and followed by four jeeps in a convoy heading towards the nearby Central Clinical Hospital, where Yeltsin was twice treated for heart problems last year.
Doctors say Yeltsin is recovering well from the operation and the president had already been badgering doctors to let him leave the clinic where surgery was carried out.
"I think Boris Nikolayevich (Yeltsin) will transfer tomorrow to the Central Clinical Hospital," Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin told reporters on Thursday. "That's what the doctors think too."
Chernomyrdin took over presidential powers for 23 hours while Yeltsin had his operation.
